verses.1: And when man began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born to him.
verses.2: And the children of God saw that the daughters of man were good. So they took wives from all those whom they chose.
verses.3: And the LORD said, “Let no spirit ever possess a person forever, even though he were a man. His lifespan would be one hundred and twenty years.”
verses.4: In those days, the vampires lived in this land. And even after that, when the children of God came into the women’s world and gave birth to those vampires, those vampires continued to exist from that time onward.
verses.5: And Jehovah saw that there was great evil on the earth, and that all the thoughts of people were only evil. Every day was filled with evil.
verses.6: And Jehovah was comforted, for He had created man on the earth. And He settled him in His heart.
verses.7: And the LORD said, “I will destroy that man whom I created from above the earth—from man to animals, to birds, and even to the smallest creatures in the heavens. For I have become angry because of what you have done.”
verses.8: And Noah was pleasing to the eyes of Jehovah.
verses.9: These are the children of Noah. Noah was a righteous man who lived in his time. He walked with God.
verses.10: And Noah had three sons. Their names were Ham, Japheth, and Canaan.
verses.11: And the earth trembled before God, and the earth was filled with smoke.
verses.12: And God saw the earth, and it seemed to be covered with mud. It seemed as though all living things were going astray on that land.
verses.13: And God said to Noah, “The days of all living things are coming to an end before me. The earth is filled with violence because of them. I will destroy them and the earth itself.”
verses.14: Make for yourself a chest of acacia wood. You shall make the chest, and then you may take it out from inside the house and from outside the courtyard.
verses.15: And this is what you must do: It should be three miles in length, fifty miles in width, and thirty miles in height.
verses.16: The door will be made into a table, and at the top, I will place two or thirty of them.
verses.17: And I will bring the flood of water upon the earth, so that all living creatures that have spirits beneath the heavens will be destroyed. All those that are on the earth will perish.
verses.18: And I have made a covenant with you. You and your children, along with your wives and children’s wives, will be among those who are under my rule.
verses.19: And from all living things, from all animals, two will be brought forth to live with you. They will be male and female.
verses.20: From every kind of animal, and from every kind of bird, from all the creatures of the earth, two will come to you in order to live.
verses.21: And you shall take for yourself from all the food that can be eaten. You will gather it for yourself and for them, so that it will be food for you and for them.
verses.22: And Noah did all that God commanded him to do. He acted accordingly.
